en: Montana Messenger now carries the messenger alone: the pages, settings and network roads of the other Montana applications are no longer part of it.
ru: Montana Messenger теперь несёт только мессенджер: страницы, настройки и сетевые дороги других приложений Монтаны больше не входят в него.
zh-Hans: Montana Messenger 现在只包含信使本身：其他 Montana 应用的页面、设置和网络通道不再属于它。

en: No new server, network road or key leaving the device. Montana Messenger is compiled with the condition MONTANA_MESSENGER in the app and in its three extensions (Share, notifications, screen broadcast); the code of the Protocol's network applications stands outside it (#if !MONTANA_MESSENGER), the app reads no foreign network interface, and it publishes the addresses of its own Wi-Fi, wired and cellular links alone (MontanaOverlayBook.candidates). The Protocol's behaviour is unchanged.
